objective: Evidence-backed JNU decision architecture with strict data integrity, OOS validation and no post-hoc rescue.

rules: Historical session versions must be date-correct.
Predictors must be available strictly before target decision time.
Contract/trading-day/roll identity must be resolved before signal evaluation.
Licensing/storage boundary is part of data integrity.

layers.rule: Interpret signals conditionally by OSE/Japan cash/lunch/bridge/night/US/post-US session; no universal all-session weight.
Determine which venue/region is informative now; not standalone directional alpha.
layers.blocked_on: Approved venue-specific OSE + SGX intraday data.

admitted_candidates.true_jnu_data_policy: 225Labo raw local-only under personal-use terms; cloud receives non-reconstructive derived panel/results only.

layers.gate: Must improve frozen OOS MSE with bootstrap P>=0.95 and sign accuracy not worse.
layers.rule: No universal one-day USDJPY state is admitted. Any future FX design must be a newly preregistered family.

results.guardrail: Do not rescue post hoc by selecting the high-VIX subset.

layers.current_family: Broad GDELT six-category prior-day state screen
layers.gate: QLIKE and MSE improve; QLIKE bootstrap P>=0.95; recent QLIKE/MSE nonnegative; Holm family correction passes.
layers.rule: News begins as volatility/event/confidence state; directional use requires a separate preregistered test.

results.reason: Full preregistered panel could not be acquired under bounded multi-year, annual-chunk, adaptive-split, and final paced single-connection protocols.
results.guardrail: Do not interpret as model FAIL; do not lower gates or drop categories post hoc.

results.first30: Expected negative beta observed but OOS MSE and hit rate worsened; bootstrap P=0.1385.
results.last30: Expected positive beta not stable; bootstrap P=0.6175.
results.guardrail: Do not tune 30-minute windows, switch SPX to NQ, or add indicators to rescue this sample.

layers.rule: Do not infer order imbalance from OHLC/VWAP/volume. Use microstructure features for execution/invalidation unless separately validated as directional.
Only validated or explicitly conditional modules may influence probabilities. Rejected families cannot re-enter without a new preregistration.

active_research.rule: No active formal family. USDJPY current spec is FAIL; broad GDELT news is DATA_INCONCLUSIVE.

next_gate: Select exactly one next family from the evidence-first priority queue; blocked candidates must remain blocked.
